meaning: Native summaries of the container clock family (container-clock-fixtures.ts) in Factorio 2.1.21, each with the selection container-clock.generation.test.ts pins. Unlike the belt-fed families, whose cuts last 2 periods, each supply cut lasts until the container's stock of the cut input is gone (its slots and stack sizes from the game data, plus 8 periods): a container between two inserters is a buffer, which a 2-period cut does not disturb. Recovery is judged over 40 periods after each disturbance, the first 6 after the release left out. Do not compare these recordings period for period with the 2-period families.
